t: This is Portman Square, a garden square in Marylebone surrounded by townhouses. It was built for private housing let on long leases, and the Portman Estate still owns the private gardens in the middle. The square marks the western end of Wigmore Street. Some notable people lived or died in these houses. Louise, Princess Royal, eldest daughter of Edward the Seventh, lived and died here. The Irish orator Henry Grattan died here, as did John Shore, Lord Teignmouth, a Governor-General of Bengal. Claude Montefiore, founder of Liberal Judaism in Britain, both lived and died here.
